NAM-INDIA.d: Nippon Life India Asset Management Limited manages mutual funds, alternative investment funds, and portfolio management services. It serves individual and institutional investors across India.

NATCOPHARM.d: Natco Pharma manufactures finished dosage formulations and active pharmaceutical ingredients with a focus on oncology products. It sells its pharmaceutical products in domestic and international markets.

NATIONALUM.d: National Aluminium Company Limited engages in the mining of bauxite, production of alumina, and manufacturing of aluminum metal. It is a state-owned Navratna company.

NAUKRI.d: The company operates online classified portals for recruitment, real estate, matrimony, and education services in India. Its flagship platform is Naukri.com.

NAVA.d: Nava operates power generation plants, ferroalloys manufacturing facilities, and mining operations. It serves industrial energy consumers and metallurgical markets.

NAVINFLUOR.d: Navin Fluorine International Limited produces specialty organofluorines, inorganic fluorides, and refrigerants for pharmaceutical and agrochemical industries. It supplies chemical intermediates to domestic and international markets.

NAZARA.d: Nazara Technologies Limited develops and publishes mobile games across genres such as esports, interactive gaming, and gamified early learning. It operates a diversified digital entertainment platform with global reach.

NBCC.d: NBCC (India) Limited operates as a state-owned civil construction enterprise engaged in project management consultancy, real estate development, and infrastructure works. It executes projects primarily for central and state governments.

NESTLEIND.d: Nestle India Limited manufactures and markets packaged foods, including milk products, nutrition, prepared dishes, and beverages. It sells its products directly to consumers through a vast retail distribution network.

NETWEB.d: Netweb Technologies India designs and manufactures high-end computing systems, private cloud solutions, and supercomputing infrastructure. Its customers include enterprises, research institutions, and government bodies.

NEULANDLAB.d: Neuland Laboratories manufactures active pharmaceutical ingredients, advanced intermediates, and custom synthesis solutions. It serves global pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies.

NH.d: Narayana Hrudayalaya Ltd. operates a network of multi-specialty hospitals and heart centers. It provides affordable healthcare services to patients in India and the Cayman Islands.

NHPC.d: The company generates and sells hydroelectric power to various state utilities in India. It is a state-owned enterprise under the Ministry of Power.

NLCINDIA.d: NLC India Limited is a state-owned power generation company that operates lignite and coal-based thermal power plants, as well as renewable energy installations. It supplies electricity primarily to southern Indian state utilities.

NMDC.d: NMDC Limited explores and produces iron ore, diamond, and other minerals in India. It is a state-owned enterprise and the country's single largest iron ore producer.

NSLNISP.d: NMDC Steel Limited produces hot-rolled steel products from its integrated steel plant in Chhattisgarh. Its main customers are manufacturing industries, infrastructure companies, and steel traders.

NTPC.d: NTPC Limited generates and sells bulk electricity to state power utilities and distribution companies across India. It is a state-owned power producer operating thermal, hydro, and renewable energy plants.

NTPCGREEN.d: NTPC Green Energy Limited generates renewable energy through solar and wind power projects. It supplies electricity to state utilities and industrial consumers.

NUVAMA.d: Nuvama Wealth Management Limited provides wealth management, broking, and asset management services to affluent individuals and institutional clients. It is a notable wealth manager in India, spun out of the Edelweiss Group.

NYKAA.d: FSN E-Commerce Ventures operates online and offline retail platforms specializing in beauty, personal care, and fashion products. It serves retail consumers across India through its digital apps and physical stores.
